# ANVRiksh Tech Solutions LLP

> Sovereign Agentic AI Orchestration, Autonomous Calling Agents, and Enterprise Custom Software Engineering.
> Registration: LLPIN ADA-3944 | Headquarters: Belgaum, Karnataka, India | Website: https://anvriksh.com

ANVRiksh is an India-based deep-technology firm specializing in Sovereign Agentic AI, Autonomous Voice Calling Agents, Genquantaa GTM OS, Modern Data Engineering, Generative AI / LLM Solutions, and Enterprise Web & Custom Software.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Sovereign Agentic AI & Autonomous Multi-Agent Swarms
- **URL**: https://anvriksh.com/agentic-ai
- **Description**: Production-grade multi-agent architectures using LangGraph, CrewAI, and deterministic guardrails. Features dynamic ReAct planning loops, tool use (SQL, APIs, bash, webhooks), self-reflection, automated error recovery, and sub-380ms routing latency.

### 2. AI Voice Generator & Autonomous Calling Agents
- **URL**: https://anvriksh.com/calling-agent
- **Description**: Sub-second conversational AI calling agents with human-like warmth and real-time audio waveforms. Multilingual support across 100+ languages including Kannada, Hindi, Marathi, and Indian English. Supports live DTMF keypad navigation, intelligent call routing, CRM synchronization, and automated inbound/outbound support.

### 3. Genquantaa GTM OS (Revenue Automation Platform)
- **URL**: https://anvriksh.com/platform
- **Description**: 24 modular AI agents orchestrating end-to-end Go-To-Market pipelines: ICP discovery, AI lead enrichment, automated multi-channel outreach (Email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Voice), meeting booking, and predictive revenue analytics.

### 4. Custom Software Development & Web Engineering
- **URL**: https://anvriksh.com/software-solutions
- **Description**: High-performance React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python enterprise software. Custom web applications, cloud DevOps, API integrations, and scalable microservices.
- **SEO, AEO & GEO Engine**: Technical Search Engine Optimization, Answer Engine Optimization (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude citation readiness), and Generative Engine Optimization for modern AI search.

### 5. Cloud Data Engineering & Lakehouse Solutions
- **URL**: https://anvriksh.com/data-solutions
- **Description**: Modern data platforms built on Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks Lakehouse, and PySpark. Implementation of Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold), streaming ETL/ELT pipelines, automated schema validation, and Power BI dashboards.

### 6. Generative AI & Sovereign LLM Solutions
- **URL**: https://anvriksh.com/gen-ai
- **Description**: Private on-premises and sovereign cloud Generative AI systems. Multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), domain-specific LLM fine-tuning (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Claude, GPT-4o), vector embeddings, and zero-data-leakage governance.

### 7. AI-Driven Digital Marketing & Performance Growth
- **URL**: https://anvriksh.com/digital-marketing
- **Description**: High-ROAS Google & Meta performance ad management, AI video creative generation, automated social posting, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and measurable B2B inbound acquisition.
